source.citation: Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-a.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಅ, 00:00.0–00:03.4 (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
source.variation: The 35-frame animation writes ಅ in one uninterrupted run: compact left loop, broad lower bowl, rounded right loop, then the inner horizontal bar returning left. This attested pedagogical order is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline rather than copying the animation's handwritten proportions.

frames.label: turn clockwise around the compact left loop
sweep around the broad lower bowl
turn counterclockwise around the rounded right loop
return left along the inward horizontal bar

source.citation: Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-aa.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಆ, 35 frames, 3.5 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
source.variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಆ in two pen-down runs: turn around the compact left loop and sweep through the broad lower bowl to the upper right; lift once, turn around the rounded right loop, then return left along the inner horizontal bar. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten loop width, bowl depth, and bar length vary, but the one-lift order remains the same.

frames.label: turn clockwise around the compact left loop
sweep around the broad lower bowl and finish at the upper right
lift, then turn clockwise around the rounded right loop
return left along the inward horizontal bar

source.citation: Yogesh, Animation of hand-writing Kannada character "ಇ".gif, independent vowel ಇ, 98 frames, 4.6 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 26 December 2015)
source.variation: The 98-frame animation writes ಇ in one uninterrupted run: climb the left upright, turn over the first arch and descend the middle stem, retrace that stem upward into the second arch, descend the broad outer curve, then close the lower loop and sweep out right. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten arch height, loop angularity, and exit length vary, but the zero-lift order remains the same.

frames.label: climb the left upright, turn over the first arch, and descend the middle stem
retrace the middle stem upward and turn over the second arch
descend through the broad outer curve and turn left along the base
close the lower loop and sweep out to the right

source.citation: Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ee.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಈ, 44 frames, 4.4 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
source.variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಈ in two pen-down runs: the broad rounded body returns to its upper-right join, sweeps the upper bar left, retraces it right, and curls upward; after one lift, the horizontal crossbar runs left to right and continues through the small right loop into the lower hook. The learner path fits that one-lift order to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline rather than inferring handwriting from print alone.

frames.label: draw the broad rounded body and return to its upper-right join
sweep the upper bar left, retrace it right, and curl upward
lift, then draw the horizontal crossbar from left to right
turn around the small right loop and descend into the lower hook

source.variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಉ in one uninterrupted run: turn around the compact upper-left loop, descend through the left shoulder and broad lower-left bowl, climb over the tall middle arch into the lower-right bowl, then sweep around the outer-right curve and finish at the open upper terminal. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten loop width, bowl depth, arch height, and terminal angle vary, but the zero-lift order remains the same.

frames.label: turn counterclockwise around the compact upper-left loop
descend through the left shoulder and sweep around the broad lower-left bowl
climb over the tall middle arch and descend into the lower-right bowl
sweep around the outer-right curve and finish at the open upper terminal

source.variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಊ in one uninterrupted run: turn around the compact upper-left spiral, descend through the left shoulder and broad lower-left bowl, climb over two joined tall arches, then descend the outer-right curve and curl around the small lower-right spiral. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten spiral size, bowl depth, arch height, and join width vary, but the zero-lift order remains the same.

frames.label: turn counterclockwise around the compact upper-left spiral
descend through the left shoulder and sweep around the broad lower-left bowl
climb over the first tall arch, descend through the middle trough, and climb over the second arch

source.citation: Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ru.gif, animation of Kannada independent vowel ಋ, 59 frames, 5.9 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
source.variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಋ in three pen-down runs: the upper-left spiral descends into the lower-left spiral and continues through the rounded middle bowl; after a lift, an inward bar curls upward into the high hook; after a second lift, the right bowl sweeps from the lower join around to its open upper terminal. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline; handwritten spiral size, bowl width, and hook height vary, but the two-lift order remains the same.

frames.label: turn clockwise around the compact upper-left spiral
descend through the outer curve and curl around the lower-left spiral
sweep through the join and around the rounded middle bowl
lift, then draw the inward bar from left to right
curl upward into the high hook
lift, then sweep rightward around the lower bowl
climb the outer side and finish at the open upper terminal
